articles.title: Taking the Message to the Grassroots in Ward 1, Ibarapa East
articles.author: Hon. Babatunde Ogunlade Campaign Media Team
articles.metaDescription: The Hon. Babatunde Ogunlade (Babs) campaign team visited Ijesha Village, Baba Mogba Village, Agele Village, and local Fulani settlement camps in Ward 1, Ibarapa East to engage residents and community leaders ahead of 2027.
articles.source: Campaign update issued by the Hon. Babatunde Ogunlade Campaign Media Team.
articles.summary: The Hon. Babatunde Ogunlade (Babs) campaign team visited Ijesha Village, Baba Mogba Village, Agele Village, and local Fulani settlement camps in Ward 1, Ibarapa East to engage residents and community leaders ahead of 2027.
body: Our campaign team recently visited communities across Ward 1, Ibarapa East, sharing the vision and message of Hon. Babatunde Ogunlade (Babs) alongside all other All Progressives Congress (APC) candidates.

During the tour, the team engaged directly with residents, elders, and community leaders across key agrarian and pastoral settlements, including Ijesha Village, Baba Mogba Village, Agele Village, and local Fulani settlement camps.

Inclusive representation starts with listening to every voice—from our farming communities to our pastoral settlements. We extend our sincere gratitude to the good people of Ward 1 for the warm reception, hospitality, and meaningful conversations as we work together toward a stronger, more united Ibarapa East.

articles.title: Ogunlade Thanks Lukman Atunwa for Donation of Campaign-Branded Caps
articles.source: Statement issued by the Media and Publicity Directorate, BABS Campaign Organization, dated 22 November 2026.
articles.summary: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade has commended Hon. Lukman Atunwa for donating campaign-branded caps to the BABS Campaign Organization at the Ibarapa East APC Party House in Eruwa.
body: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade, popularly known as BABS and the All Progressives Congress (APC) candidate for the Oyo State House of Assembly in Ibarapa East State Constituency, has expressed his profound appreciation to Hon. Lukman Atunwa for his generous donation of campaign-branded caps in support of the BABS Campaign Organization.
The presentation, which took place on 22 November 2026 at the Ibarapa East APC Party House in Eruwa, brought together party leaders, stakeholders and supporters from across the constituency.
Hon. Ogunlade described the gesture as a timely and commendable demonstration of solidarity, loyalty and collective commitment to the success of the All Progressives Congress in Ibarapa East.

On behalf of the BABS Campaign Organization and the progressive family across Eruwa, Lanlate and all wards in Ibarapa East, Ogunlade expressed heartfelt appreciation to Atunwa for the donation, saying the campaign-branded caps would strengthen grassroots mobilization, enhance campaign visibility and energize supporters.

He further said that support from party stalwarts reinforces unity, cooperation and collective determination to advance good governance, inclusive representation and sustainable development across Ibarapa East.
Ogunlade called on party faithful, youth groups, women leaders, community mobilizers and other stakeholders across Eruwa and Lanlate to remain united, focused and active in grassroots engagement.
The BABS Campaign Organization thanked Atunwa for his generosity and commitment to the progressive family.

articles.title: Ogunlade Congratulates Babarinde on Installation as Bamofin of Aborerin Eruwa
articles.source: Congratulatory statement issued by Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade, dated 21 November 2026.
articles.summary: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade congratulated Chief Barrister Samson Oyetunji Babarinde on his installation as Bamofin of Aborerin Eruwa, describing the honour as recognition of community service.
body: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade, the All Progressives Congress (APC) candidate for the Ibarapa East Constituency seat in the Oyo State House of Assembly, has congratulated Chief Barrister Samson Oyetunji Babarinde on his installation as the Bamofin of Aborerin Eruwa.
Babarinde was installed by the Baale of Aborerin Eruwa, High Chief Olaide Ojedapo. He is also a chieftain of the APC in the Ibarapa East Constituency.
In a congratulatory message, Ogunlade described the honour as a fitting recognition of a man who has served his community with dedication, integrity and a deep sense of responsibility.

“As a respected legal practitioner and a committed chieftain of our great party, the All Progressives Congress, in Ibarapa East Constituency, Chief Babarinde has consistently shown that leadership means service to the people,” Ogunlade said.
The candidate commended the Baale of Aborerin Eruwa, High Chief Olaide Ojedapo, for what he called a wise choice, and congratulated the people of Aborerin on the milestone.
Ogunlade expressed confidence that the new Bamofin would use his position to promote peace, unity and development in Aborerin, Eruwa and the whole of Ibarapa East.
“Our traditional institutions remain the custodians of our culture and values, and it is the duty of all of us to support and strengthen them,” he said.
He also prayed that God would grant the new Bamofin good health, wisdom and strength as he takes up the responsibility, and that his tenure would bring lasting progress to his people.
Ogunlade is the APC candidate for the Ibarapa East Constituency ahead of the 2027 general elections.

articles.title: Hon. BABS Attends Unveiling of 2027 CAN Calendar in Aborerin Zone, Eruwa
articles.source: Statement published on the official Facebook page of Hon. Ogunlade Babatunde Sunday (BABS).
articles.summary: Hon. Babatunde Ogunlade attended the unveiling of the Christian Association of Nigeria, Aborerin Zone, 2027 calendar at Jesus Healing Christ Church Aladura, Oke Aseye, Eruwa.
body: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade, popularly known as BABS, attended the unveiling and launch of the 2027 calendar of the Christian Association of Nigeria (CAN), Aborerin Zone, Eruwa.

The event took place at Jesus Healing Christ Church Aladura, Oke Aseye, in Aborerin, Eruwa. In a statement published after the programme, Ogunlade commended the leadership of CAN Aborerin Zone for what he described as its continuing prayers and spiritual guidance for the community.
The statement presented the engagement as part of efforts to maintain relations with faith-based institutions in the area.

articles.title: Hon. BABS Thanks Hon. Remi Oseni for Attending Reception of Father’s Burial Ceremony
articles.source: Statement published on the official Facebook page of Hon. Ogunlade Babatunde Sunday (BABS).
articles.summary: Ogunlade issued a message of appreciation following Hon. Remi Oseni’s attendance at the reception held for his late father, Pa Idowu Ishola Ogunlade.
body: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade has expressed appreciation to Hon. Remi Oseni for attending the reception held as part of the burial ceremonies for his father, Pa Idowu Ishola Ogunlade.

The reception took place at Eleruwa Stadium, Eruwa. In the message, Ogunlade described Oseni’s presence as a gesture of solidarity with the family and thanked him for joining relatives, friends and well-wishers in honouring the late patriarch.
The statement was issued in Ogunlade’s name and identified him as the APC candidate for the Ibarapa East State Constituency seat in the Oyo State House of Assembly.

articles.title: More Than 100 NDC Members in Ibarapa East Announce Plans to Join APC
articles.source: SpyGist Media report, 16 November 2026.
articles.summary: More than 100 NDC members, including local and ward officers, announced an intention to join the APC; the announcement described a planned move, not a completed defection.
body: More than 100 members of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) in Ibarapa East Local Government Area have announced plans to leave the party and join the All Progressives Congress (APC), following a meeting involving MC Swagger, APC stakeholders and party executives.

The group said its decision followed consultations and dissatisfaction with the NDC’s leadership direction and internal affairs. Those identified as leading the proposed move included local government organising secretary Fashina Segun, publicity secretary Aderoju Babatunde, financial secretary Ogunleke Thomas and Ward 4 chairman, Mr Opeyemi.

Aderoju Babatunde said the group wanted to align with a political platform it believed offered better opportunities for participation and electoral success. Members also said they intended to support APC candidates through grassroots mobilisation, including house-to-house engagement.

The announcement concerned an intention to defect. The report did not establish that formal membership transfers had been completed. The group was expected to proceed through the appropriate APC membership processes.

articles.title: Drilling Works at Third Borehole Location in Anunimorigba Community, Lanlate, Completed
articles.source: Campaign update published on the official Facebook page of Hon. Ogunlade Babatunde Sunday (BABS).
articles.summary: A campaign update announced that drilling works at a third borehole location in Anunimorigba Community, Lanlate, had been completed.
body: A campaign update issued on 10 November 2026 announced the completion of drilling works at a third borehole location in Anunimorigba Community, Lanlate.
The announcement thanked people involved in the effort and described the work as part of an initiative intended to improve access to clean water in the area.

The update did not provide technical details, commissioning arrangements or information on when the facility would become operational. The completion statement is therefore presented as reported by the campaign.

articles.title: APC Approves Drilling of Three New Boreholes Across Eruwa and Lanlate
articles.source: Campaign announcement published on the official Facebook page of Hon. Ogunlade Babatunde Sunday (BABS).
articles.summary: The campaign announced approval for three boreholes across Eruwa and Lanlate and said drilling had begun behind Baptist Day School, Sango Eruwa.
body: A campaign announcement dated 10 November 2026 said the All Progressives Congress (APC) had approved the drilling of three boreholes across Eruwa and Lanlate.
The statement identified Hon. Babatunde Ogunlade as the facilitator of the initiative and said work had commenced at the first location behind Baptist Day School, Sango Eruwa.

The announcement described the proposed facilities as an effort to improve access to water. It did not set out a project budget, contractor details or completion timetable. The approval and commencement information is attributed to the campaign announcement.

articles.title: Hon. Babatunde Joins APC Leaders at Turbaning of Alhaji Lateef Ajiboye Akinsanya
articles.source: Statement published on the official Facebook page of Hon. Ogunlade Babatunde Sunday (BABS).
articles.summary: Ogunlade attended the installation of Alhaji Lateef Ajiboye Akinsanya as the first Aare Musulumi of Eruwaland and its environs.
body: Hon. Babatunde Ogunlade joined All Progressives Congress leaders and other guests at the installation of Alhaji Lateef Ajiboye Akinsanya as the first Aare Musulumi of Eruwaland and its environs.

The campaign statement identified Akinsanya as the Oyo State APC Treasurer and a former chairman of the party in Ibarapa East. It said the ceremony in Eruwa was attended by the state party chairman, Chief Moses Alake, governorship candidate Senator Sharafadeen Alli, deputy governorship candidate Hon. Adesoji Adedeji, party executives and community elders.
The statement congratulated Akinsanya on the title and described the occasion as an opportunity to recognise his service to the Muslim community and the wider area.

articles.title: Ibarapa East APC Campaign Council Calls for Calm over Disputed Billboard Posters
articles.source: Statement of the Ibarapa East APC Campaign Council, reported by SpyGist Media on 27 October 2026.
articles.summary: The campaign council alleged that APM posters had been placed on an APC billboard and urged political actors to avoid actions that could heighten tensions.
body: The Ibarapa East All Progressives Congress (APC) Campaign Council has called for calm following what it described as the alleged placement of Allied Peoples Movement (APM) posters on an APC campaign billboard in the local government area.

In a statement issued by the council’s communications officials, the council characterised the alleged act as provocative and warned that disputes over campaign materials could create misunderstanding among political supporters. The allegation was made by the APC campaign council; the statement did not include an independent account from the APM or identify those responsible.

The council urged political parties and their supporters to respect one another, avoid inflammatory conduct and focus on issue-based campaigning. It also appealed to APC supporters to remain calm while the matter was addressed.
The council reaffirmed its stated commitment to peaceful political engagement and called for conduct that supports coexistence across Ibarapa East.

articles.title: Babatunde Adeyemi Mobilises Support for APC Candidates Ahead of 2027 Elections
articles.source: SpyGist Media report, 27 October 2026.
articles.summary: Eruwa-born businessman Babatunde Sunday Adeyemi is reported to be mobilising support for four APC figures contesting different offices ahead of 2027.
body: Eruwa-born businessman Babatunde Sunday Adeyemi is mobilising support for four All Progressives Congress (APC) figures ahead of the 2027 general elections, according to campaign activity described in a report published by SpyGist Media.

The report identified the figures as President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, Senator Sharafadeen Abiodun Alli, Hon. Remi Oseni and Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade. Their respective contests were described as the presidential, Oyo State governorship, senatorial and Ibarapa East State Constituency races.

Adeyemi’s reported mobilisation is focused on party members, supporters and political stakeholders in Ibarapa East, including Eruwa, Lanlate and surrounding communities. The report also referred to his earlier comments following an APC tour of Ibarapa.
The report describes Adeyemi’s stated political support and mobilisation activity. It does not imply that party nomination procedures or electoral outcomes have been determined.

articles.title: Babatunde Adeyemi Praises Turnout at APC Tour of Ibarapa
articles.source: SpyGist Media report, 25 October 2026.
articles.summary: Babatunde Sunday Adeyemi praised APC supporters’ turnout during a party tour and expressed confidence in Senator Sharafadeen Alli’s governorship bid.
body: Babatunde Sunday Adeyemi has praised APC members and supporters who attended the party’s recent tour of Ibarapa, describing the turnout as an encouraging sign of grassroots engagement ahead of the 2027 elections.
Adeyemi said the tour gave Senator Sharafadeen Abiodun Alli an opportunity to interact with traditional rulers, religious leaders, young people, support groups and other stakeholders across the area.

He expressed confidence in Alli’s capacity to promote development and improve residents’ welfare if elected governor of Oyo State. Adeyemi described the senator as a promise keeper and urged party members and supporters to sustain their mobilisation.
The remarks represent Adeyemi’s assessment of the event and his political view of the governorship candidate.

articles.title: Ogunlade Holds Engagements with Water Base Group and Lanlate Community Association
articles.source: Update published on the official Facebook page of Hon. Ogunlade Babatunde Sunday (BABS).
articles.summary: The campaign reported meetings with the Water Base Group, Anunimorigba Landlord Association in Lanlate and other community groups.
body: Hon. Babatunde Ogunlade has continued a series of grassroots engagements, according to an update published by his campaign on 24 October 2026.

The update identified the Water Base Group and the Anunimorigba Landlord Association in Lanlate among the groups met. It also referred to engagements with other groups but did not provide their names, meeting dates or a detailed account of the discussions.

The campaign described the meetings as part of its effort to take its message to community organisations and residents. No formal resolutions or commitments arising from the meetings were listed in the update.

articles.title: Ogunlade Meets Executive Council of National Association of Lanlate Students
articles.source: Update published on the official Facebook page of Hon. Ogunlade Babatunde Sunday (BABS).
articles.summary: Ogunlade, accompanied by members of the Patriotic Progressives Network, met the executive council of the National Association of Lanlate Students.
body: Hon. Babatunde Ogunlade met with the executive council of the National Association of Lanlate Students (NALS) during an engagement in Ibarapa East, according to a campaign update published on 22 October 2026.
The statement said Ogunlade was accompanied by Hon. Lanre Olaosegba, Hon. Oloyede Raji and members of the Patriotic Progressives Network (PPN), Ibarapa East.

The campaign described the meeting as an opportunity to engage student representatives and hear youth perspectives. The published update did not provide a list of issues raised by the students or specific agreements reached at the meeting.

articles.title: APC Campaign Council Reports Stakeholder Consultations in Ibarapa East
articles.source: Statement of the Ibarapa East APC Campaign Council, published by SpyGist Media on 22 October 2026.
articles.summary: The campaign council reported a consultative meeting involving APC candidates and traditional, religious, occupational, youth and student representatives.
body: The Ibarapa East APC Campaign Council has reported holding a consultative meeting with traditional, religious, occupational, youth and student representatives as part of its political engagement ahead of the 2027 elections.

According to the statement, the consultations included the Eleruwa and his chiefs, the Eruwa Elders Council, traditional worshippers, the Christian Association of Nigeria, Muslim leaders, artisans, traders, youth associations, student representatives and party members.

The statement said governorship candidate Senator Sharafadeen Abiodun Alli spoke about development-focused politics and pledged to give Ibarapa East attention if elected. Deputy governorship candidate Hon. Adesoji Adedeji was also reported to have addressed youth inclusion.

The account was issued by the campaign council and records the council’s description of the meeting and remarks. It does not constitute an independent assessment of public support or a verification of future commitments.

articles.title: Ibarapa East APC Youth Summit Holds with Adesoji Adedeji in Attendance
articles.source: Statement published on the official Facebook page of Hon. Ogunlade Babatunde Sunday (BABS).
articles.summary: A campaign statement thanked participants and organisers following an Ibarapa East APC Youth Summit attended by deputy governorship candidate Hon. Adesoji Adedeji.
body: The Ibarapa East APC Youth Summit was held with the party’s deputy governorship candidate, Hon. Adesoji Adedeji, in attendance, according to a statement published by Hon. Babatunde Ogunlade’s campaign on 21 October 2026.

The statement thanked young participants, organisers, stakeholders and guests for attending. It described the summit as an opportunity to bring young party members together and encourage continued engagement.
The update did not provide the venue, attendance figures, programme agenda or resolutions adopted at the summit.

articles.title: Ogunlade Receives Senator Alli during Ibarapa East Consultative Tour
articles.source: Statement published on the official Facebook page of Hon. Ogunlade Babatunde Sunday (BABS).
articles.summary: Ogunlade reported receiving Senator Sharafadeen Alli and a delegation for consultations with traditional, religious, occupational and community stakeholders.
body: Hon. Babatunde Ogunlade said he received Oyo State APC governorship candidate Senator Sharafadeen Abiodun Alli and deputy governorship candidate Hon. Adesoji Adedeji during a consultative tour of Ibarapa East.

In his published statement, Ogunlade said the delegation also included senatorial candidate Hon. Aderemi Abass Oseni and federal constituency candidate Hon. Niyi Yusuf. The reported engagements involved traditional councils in Eruwa and Lanlate, Christian and Muslim communities, artisans, traders and pensioners.

The statement thanked traditional rulers, religious leaders, community representatives and residents who attended. Its description of the reception and level of support reflects the candidate’s account of the visit.

articles.title: Ogunlade Welcomes Senator Sharafadeen Alli to Ibarapa
articles.source: Statement published on the official Facebook page of Hon. Ogunlade Babatunde Sunday (BABS).
articles.summary: Ogunlade issued a welcome message ahead of Senator Sharafadeen Alli’s visit to Ibarapa.
body: Hon. Babatunde Ogunlade has welcomed Senator Sharafadeen Abiodun Alli to Ibarapa in a message published ahead of the governorship candidate’s visit to the area.

In the statement, Ogunlade said the visit offered an opportunity to engage communities and expressed support for Alli’s stated ambition to lead Oyo State. He also called on residents and party members to receive the delegation.
The message was issued in Ogunlade’s capacity as the APC candidate for the Ibarapa East State Constituency seat in the Oyo State House of Assembly.

articles.title: Ogunlade Joins Oyo APC Assembly Candidates at PBAT Walk with AlliSoji 2027
articles.source: Statement published on the official Facebook page of Hon. Ogunlade Babatunde Sunday (BABS).
articles.summary: Ogunlade reported participating in the PBAT Walk with AlliSoji 2027 alongside other Oyo State APC House of Assembly candidates.
body: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade said he joined fellow Oyo State APC House of Assembly candidates at the PBAT Walk with AlliSoji 2027.

In a statement published after the event, Ogunlade described the gathering as an expression of party unity and support for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and the APC. He identified unity, peace and governance as themes of the party’s message ahead of the 2027 elections.
The statement did not provide the event venue, attendance figures or a detailed programme.

articles.title: MC Swagger Appointed Deputy Director-General of APC Ibarapa East Campaign Communications
articles.source: SpyGist Media report, 21 September 2026.
articles.summary: Amb. (Dr) Opeyemi Ayanrinde, known as MC Swagger, was reported appointed Deputy Director-General of Media and Strategic Communication for the APC Ibarapa East Campaign Council.
body: Amb. (Dr) Opeyemi Ayanrinde, popularly known as MC Swagger, was appointed Deputy Director-General of the Media and Strategic Communication Directorate of the APC Ibarapa East Campaign Council for the 2027 general elections, according to a report published on 21 September 2026.

The report described Ayanrinde as a broadcaster, entertainer and political mobiliser with more than two decades of experience across broadcasting, media and grassroots engagement. It also outlined previous roles in the Association of Nigerian Broadcasters, political mobilisation and campaign communications.

In an acceptance message shared on his social media platforms, Ayanrinde thanked APC leaders, stakeholders, executives and members across the ten wards of Ibarapa East for the confidence placed in him. He said he intended to apply his professional and media experience to the assignment.
The appointment and career details are presented as reported by SpyGist Media at the time of publication.

articles.title: Ogunlade Commends Nigerian Army’s Civil-Military Project at Eruwa General Hospital
articles.source: Press statement reported by SpyGist Media on 19 September 2026.
articles.summary: Ogunlade commended the Nigerian Army’s civil-military project at Eruwa General Hospital, which the release said included hospital remodelling and a solar-powered borehole.
body: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade has commended the Nigerian Army following the commissioning of a Chief of Army Staff Civil-Military Cooperation project at Eruwa General Hospital.

The project was described in the statement as including the remodelling and reconstruction of the hospital’s VIP and physiotherapy section, as well as the provision of a solar-powered borehole intended to support water supply and healthcare delivery.

Ogunlade praised the Chief of Army Staff and the leadership of the Nigerian Army for the initiative. He also acknowledged Major General Oluremi A. Fadairo, identified in the statement as the General Officer Commanding 82 Division and Commander of Joint Task Force (South East), Operation UDO KA.

The candidate described the project as an example of institutional collaboration and said public infrastructure initiatives should respond to practical community needs. The project details and commendation are drawn from the statement issued in his name.

articles.title: BABS Campaign Announces Ten-Ward Tour and Empowerment Programme
articles.source: Schedule released by the BABS Media Team and reported by SpyGist Media on 18 September 2026.
articles.summary: The campaign announced a proposed week-long tour across Ibarapa East’s ten wards from 20 to 27 September 2026, with community meetings and planned welfare support.
body: The BABS Media Team announced a ward tour and empowerment programme planned to cover all ten wards of Ibarapa East from 20 to 27 September 2026.

According to the published schedule, activities were to begin in Eruwa on 20 September, with engagements at LA School, Oke Oba, and LA School, Isaba. The itinerary also listed meetings in New Eruwa, Lanlate, Owode Layolayo, Anwarul-Islam School, Olonade’s Compound, Koonu’s Compound and Sango.

The schedule described the programme as a combination of campaign council activities, interactive sessions and the distribution of empowerment packages. It said the intended beneficiaries included widows, older residents and people facing hardship.
The announcement set out a planned programme. It should not be read as confirmation that every scheduled activity or distribution was subsequently completed.

articles.title: APC Holds Reconciliation Meeting for Ibarapa East Aspirants and Stakeholders
articles.source: SpyGist Media report by Sunday Adeniyi Adedokun, 18 July 2026.
articles.summary: APC leaders, House of Assembly aspirants and stakeholders met in Ibarapa East as part of efforts to address internal differences ahead of the 2027 elections.
body: The All Progressives Congress (APC) leadership in Ibarapa East Local Government held a reconciliation meeting involving House of Assembly aspirants, party executives and stakeholders ahead of the 2027 general elections.

Pa Timothy Alarape Jolaoso, identified in the report as the leader of the APC in the Ibarapa zone, said reconciliation committees had been established across political levels. He disclosed that ten-member committees were constituted in each of Oyo State’s 32 State Assembly constituencies.

Participants discussed party unity and ways to strengthen internal engagement. Aspirants who spoke included Alhaji Lukman Atunwa, Barrister Silas Adepoju, Adegoke Waheed Olawale, Comrade Wale Ojewola, Mr Samin Adebare Adedeji, Mr Sodiq Egbedokun and Hon. Oladeni Bayo.

Several participants urged the party to maintain communication, engage aggrieved members and work towards reconciliation. Ogunlade, identified in the report as the party’s Ibarapa East Assembly candidate, pledged to work with party members regardless of previous differences.
The report records statements made at the meeting and the participants’ stated positions.

articles.title: Ibarapa East APC Leaders Meet Ogunlade after INEC Nomination Form Presentation
articles.source: SpyGist Media report, 15 July 2026.
articles.summary: Ogunlade presented his INEC nomination form to senior APC leaders in Ibarapa East and sought their advice and support ahead of the 2027 election.
body: Senior All Progressives Congress (APC) figures in Ibarapa East met with the party’s House of Assembly candidate, Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade, after he presented his Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) nomination form to the party’s local leadership.

The presentation took place during a consultative visit to Pa Timothy Alarape Jolaoso and Pa Dayo Adeola. The report said Ogunlade sought their prayers, guidance and support as preparations continued for the 2027 Oyo State House of Assembly election.

Ogunlade said the visit was intended to demonstrate respect for party elders and keep them involved in the next phase of his campaign. The leaders encouraged party members to remain united and focused.
The report identified the APC local government chairman, Comrade Dele Belolari, Ward 2 chairman Mr Peter Aderoju and other party executives and stakeholders as attendees.

articles.title: Ogunlade Congratulates Eleruwa on First Coronation Anniversary
articles.source: Congratulatory statement reported by SpyGist Media on 28 June 2026.
articles.summary: Ogunlade congratulated the Eleruwa of Eruwa, Oba Samuel Adebayo Adegbola Ajobo Olurin I, on the first anniversary of his coronation.
body: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade has congratulated the Eleruwa of Eruwa, His Royal Majesty Oba Samuel Adebayo Adegbola Ajobo Olurin I, on the first anniversary of the monarch’s coronation.

In a congratulatory message, Ogunlade praised the traditional ruler’s leadership and commitment to cultural preservation, peace and community development. He described the traditional institution as an important partner in grassroots development.
The statement conveyed prayers for the monarch’s continued good health, wisdom and a long reign. It was issued in Ogunlade’s name as the APC candidate for the Ibarapa East State Constituency seat.
